definitions.name: ClickUp Get Workspace User (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/user/{user_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/space. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp Get Space (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/space. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-SPACE", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-SPACE", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP DELETE-SPACE", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp List Folders (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}/folder. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/folder/{folder_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}/folder. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-FOLDER", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp Update Folder (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/folder/{folder_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-FOLDER", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp List Folder Lists (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/folder/{folder_id}/list. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/folder/{folder_id}/list. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-LIST", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}/list. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}/list. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-FOLDERLESS-LIST", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/list/{list_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/list/{list_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-LIST", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp List Workspace Tasks (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/task. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp Get Task (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: ClickUp Create Task (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/list/{list_id}/task. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-TASK", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: ClickUp Create Subtask (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/list/{list_id}/task. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-SUBTASK", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp Update Task (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-TASK", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: ClickUp Set Task Status (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP SET-TASK-STATUS", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: ClickUp Delete Task (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP DELETE-TASK", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/list/{list_id}/task/{task_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP ADD-TASK-LIST", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp Remove Task Link (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}/link/{links_to}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP REMOVE-TASK-LINK", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}/comment. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}/comment. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-TASK-COMMENT", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/list/{list_id}/comment. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/list/{list_id}/comment. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-LIST-COMMENT", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/comment/{comment_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-COMMENT", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/comment/{comment_id}/reply. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-COMMENT-REPLY", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp Create Checklist (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}/checklist. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-CHECKLIST", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/checklist/{checklist_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-CHECKLIST", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/checklist/{checklist_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP DELETE-CHECKLIST", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/checklist/{checklist_id}/checklist_item. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-CHECKLIST-ITEM", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-CHECKLIST-ITEM", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/checklist/{checklist_id}/checklist_item/{checklist_item_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP DELETE-CHECKLIST-ITEM", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.name: ClickUp List list Custom Fields (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/list/{list_id}/field. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/folder/{folder_id}/field. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}/field. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}/field/{field_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP REMOVE-CUSTOM-FIELD", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.name: ClickUp List Space Tags (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}/tag. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}/tag. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-TAG", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}/tag/{tag_name}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-TAG", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/space/{space_id}/tag/{tag_name}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP DELETE-TAG", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}/tag/{tag_name}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP ADD-TASK-TAG", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/time_entries/{timer_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/time_entries. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-TIME-ENTRY", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits
