PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/time_entries/{timer_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-TIME-ENTRY", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/time_entries/{timer_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP DELETE-TIME-ENTRY", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/time_entries/current. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/time_entries/start. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP START-TIME-ENTRY", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/time_entries/stop. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP STOP-TIME-ENTRY", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/time_entries/tags. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/goal. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/goal/{goal_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/team/{workspace_id}/goal. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-GOAL", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/goal/{goal_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-GOAL", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/goal/{goal_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP DELETE-GOAL", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/goal/{goal_id}/key_result. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP CREATE-KEY-RESULT", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

PUT https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/key_result/{key_result_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP UPDATE-KEY-RESULT", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. DELETE https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/key_result/{key_result_id}. Externally supplied personal API token (raw Authorization) or OAuth access token (Bearer). Exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken selected by config.$connection; optional tokenSecret or CLICKUP_TOKEN with explicit authMode. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="CLICKUP DELETE-KEY-RESULT", $retries=0. One request, no automatic retry, OAuth exchange/refresh, provider URL follow-up or listener. API v2 only. Tasks include subtasks through include_subtasks/subtasks flags; Create Subtask requires parent in the same List. Page is zero-based, maximum100 task rows; caller explicitly advances page; last_page is return-only. Comments return maximum25 and cursor start/start_id must be paired. Time range at most31 days; epoch/time_estimate/duration units are milliseconds, running duration can be negative. Read fields project known pinned contracts, preserving optional/null/falsy and exact integer/decimal text; only custom value/type-specific config are dynamic JSON. IDs are uncoerced exact route strings; tag names are encoded as one segment and dot-only identities rejected. Bounds: 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35,100000 values,16384 nonempty chunks,100-30000ms total Date.now deadline before profile/secrets with dispatch/read/decode/final guards. Strict UTF8/UTF16, protected errors, abort/nonblocking cleanup. Source: https://developer.clickup.com/openapi/clickup-api-v2-reference.json https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication https://developer.clickup.com/docs/tasks https://developer.clickup.com/docs/customfields https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.
